brief: amazing, yes lets use this. The only thing remaining issue now is that drowned, sea, mirror, and home all look basically identical at a quick scan. Are you able to come up with alternatives for sea and mirror?
status: Drowned 07 adopted. Sea and mirror are proposals, not installed.
constraints: Retain character-free chapter paintings. Sea is the release into first light; mirror centres the existing stool, enamel bowl, brass hoop, bubbles and fallen lights. No invented props. Smooth coherent colour without repeated diagonal swatches.

studies.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Image 1 is an open-sea composition study to refine. Image 2 is the game's approved boat design and smooth painted surface finish; borrow ONLY the round wooden hull, cream rail, soft simple red scarf sail, lantern and rendering quality from image 2, not its village, viewpoint or sunset colours.
Keep image 1's high oblique view across BLUE OPEN WATER with no horizon or sky. The whole frame is water. Make the scene calm and dreamlike: long low rounded swells with perhaps one pale rolling edge, no breakers, storm surf or churning foam. A delicate short curving wake marks the little boat's passage. Warm first-light glints from upper left touch a few broad areas, not every ripple.
Replace the long sharp yacht-like boat with the small cute rounded clinker dinghy from image 2: deep warm wooden body, broad curved planks, thick cream rail, stout mast and boom, tiny brass lantern on a cream post. It sails toward upper right in a clear three-quarter side view, complete and close enough to read. The soft red scarf sail is a gently tapered quadrilateral, no long pointed triangle, no photographic textile or knit texture.
Reframe the boat so the mast tip is at 20% of image height, the hull rests around 50–55%, and the whole vessel fits between 40% and 66% of the width. This is important: clear water above the full mast, enough margin for a widescreen crop. Preserve the cool ocean palette, softened toward clear teal-blue and slate-blue with gentle pale-gold light. Leave the lower centre naturally calm and shaded for separate UI.
Polished stylized animated-film painting; smooth coherent surfaces, soft volume, clear edges on the boat and broad painted water shapes. No diagonal swatches, triangle facets, paper grain, repeated ripple texture or dense tiny sparkle. No horizon, islands, dock, other boats, characters, animals, letters or UI. Landscape 16:9.
studies.assessment: Blue open water with no horizon; oblique boat and sweeping swell replace the rear-view sunset composition. Refined to reduce the first draft's rough sea and sharp hull. Proposal; boat-prop fidelity can be refined if selected.

studies.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
This is an Updraft Sky mirror chapter painting. Keep this composition and idea: the stool, enamel soap bowl and brass hoop are the main subject, transparent bubbles carry small gold light, everything reflected in the still surface under a lilac and peach sky. No boat.
Refine the props to match the simple, softly shaped game world: a small ROUND THREE-LEGGED wooden stool with an unadorned round seat and smooth softly shaded wood, no carved decoration, coarse grain, splitting or weathered crust. A SHALLOW pale blue-grey enamel bowl on it, less deep than the existing wash basin, with a simple blue rim and a little clear soap film. The hoop is a thin round BRASS loop with a short brass handle, resting against the stool, no wooden grip and no paddle shape. Soft clean surfaces with dimensional light, not photographic material microdetail.
Lower the uppermost star-carrying bubble so its top is around 18% of the image height, leaving generous sky above it for widescreen cropping. Keep it to the right of the hoop, clear of the props. Its centre is nearly transparent and its iridescent rim delicate. Its reflection must align directly beneath it in the same geometry as the other reflections. Retain the second smaller empty bubble. Keep the small existing surface lights subtle.
Preserve the spacious purple-blue and blush sky, calm reflections, viewpoint, naturally quiet lower centre, and the balance of objects. No regular texture, diamond swatches, triangular facets, canvas grain, paper texture, speckles or repeated brush marks. No text, UI, people, animals, land, moon or new objects. Landscape 16:9.
studies.assessment: Round three-legged stool, shallow enamel bowl, brass hoop and bubbles replace the boat as the subject. Revised from a deeper basin and rougher stool toward the actual game props.

initialPrompts.sea:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: alternate landscape chapter painting for Updraft, 16:9. OPEN SEA — the release into morning after a long dark night. This must be immediately different from a red boat against a sunset horizon.
Compose a high oblique view DOWN across enormous open blue water. The frame is almost entirely sea, with no horizon or sky visible. A small rounded honey-coloured clinker wooden boat travels diagonally toward the upper right, slightly above the centre of the painting. Its single brick-red scarf sail catches the morning breeze, a soft tapering four-sided sail on one dark mast and boom; simple clean cloth folds, no knit pattern. Show the boat in three-quarter side view, its curved cream gunwale, broad wood strakes, wooden seats and little brass lantern on a white bow post. No passengers or animals.
The visual subject is the sweeping motion of the sea: broad, long turquoise-blue and slate-blue swells, with a winding soft ivory wake curving behind the boat into the left middle distance. Daybreak light comes from outside the upper left, laying a few broad pale-gold glints across the blue. The boat's red is a small warm note in the immense cool expanse. Light and water have volume, the sea feels alive and expansive, not stormy. Quiet darker blue in the lower central area for a separately added Continue button. Keep the complete boat and rig in the central 65% of the image width and upper two-thirds, readable at thumbnail size; never tiny enough to vanish.
Style: polished luminous stylized animated-film environment painting, clean surfaces and soft gradients, simple sculptural forms, warm light against cool coloured shade, affectionate dreamlike scale. Water marks follow real swell and wake directions and vary widely in size. NOT photorealism, not vector art, not a paper-textured illustration. No grid, diagonal swatches, diamond facets, repeating ripple stamps, grain, canvas texture or mottled colour patches. No islands, shore, roofs, dock, lighthouse, people, animals, extra boats, lettering or UI. Make a complete finished painting.
initialPrompts.mirror:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: alternate SKY MIRROR chapter painting for Updraft, landscape 16:9. A still place where a child mends the sky by lifting fallen lights in soap bubbles. The painting shows the place with nobody in it.
Change the focal subject completely from the usual sailboat sunset: a low, intimate view across a small wooden stool, a pale enamel bowl of soap water, and a large thin brass bubble hoop with a short handle. The bowl sits on the stool and the hoop rests against it, ready to be picked up. These ordinary childhood objects stand in an impossibly thin clear sheet of water, with a perfect reflection below and NO land or platform showing.
Near them, two delicate transparent soap bubbles drift above the mirrored water. One carries a tiny warm gold point of starlight, a luminous pinpoint with slender rays, NOT a solid five-point star. Two other small fallen gold light points lie further away on the mirror surface. Keep these few lights distinct, not a shower of sparkles. Bubble centres remain almost clear; their edges catch pearl, rose and blue.
The whole world is a still reflection of a spacious lilac and blush-rose twilight sky, with a pale apricot seam near the horizon and broad cloud shapes mirrored below. Lower the colour intensity compared with a blazing sunset. The stool and hoop sit a little left of centre; the large bubble floats above and right of them. Group subject and its reflection within the central two-thirds of the width, leaving naturally quiet dusky reflection at lower centre for a separately added Continue button. Focal objects are legible at thumbnail size. Keep the whole hoop in frame. The horizon is a quiet distant line behind the objects, with no sun disc dominating it. No boat or jetty in the foreground; their absence from this camera view gives the room its own identity.
Style: polished luminous stylized animated-film painting, simple rounded objects, soft volume and delicately observed light. Smooth continuous colour inside each surface, no faceted or patchwork shading. Clean surfaces, soft atmospheric gradients, controlled edges. Reflections match their objects exactly. Water is almost perfectly still, with at most one faint ring near the stool, no waves. No mountains, land, clouds sitting ON the water, moon prop, people, animals, extra props, text or UI. No repeated swatches, diamond grid, canvas grain, global texture or stippling. A finished beautiful dream scene.
